summary: Ameren Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01 to furnish a press release and unaudited financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing reports first-quarter diluted EPS of $1.28, compared to $1.07 in the prior-year period, and reaffirms full-year 2026 guidance of $5.25–$5.45 per share. There are no special-situation elements—no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital-return event—only routine earnings disclosure. No deal terms or structural changes are involved. This is a standard quarterly update with no actionable risk-arb or catalyst.
